cost_tiers.T2: mid / small-residual exact solve, local search (seconds–minutes)
cost_tiers.T3: heavy / full search on the raw space (minutes–1500s, LAST resort)

weapons.name: W1_literature_grounded_structured_construction

trigger.saturation_signal: STRUCTURAL_GAP fired (plateau below known bound / self-certified maximality / compute-without-gain)
trigger.fires_before: any search; search budget GATED behind a completed structure-fetch returning coordinates

verifier.rule: independent re-check of the assembled object from scratch; a no-coordinates fetch ESCALATES to the primary paper, never falls back to search

weapons.expected_lift: saturated incumbent 90 -> exact optimum 112 (cap-set n=6, measured 2026-06-10)
weapons.failure_mode: no construction found -> escalate to primary paper, else HONEST_ABSTAIN; genuinely-open target -> do not draw (search is legitimate)

weapons.name: W2_exact_combinatorial_solver

trigger.fires_before: never drawn cold on a flat space when W1 applies; fires after structure shrinks the space

verifier.verifier_cmd: solver OPTIMAL/proof-of-bound status + independent constraint re-check of the returned object
verifier.rule: self-certifying status is still re-checked against the arena verifier

weapons.expected_lift: n<=5 cap-set optima 20/45 reached where local search stalled (18/40); 22-pt residual solved <30s
weapons.failure_mode: flat-space timeout (n=6 cold: 89/112 in 700s) -> report best-found as lower bound, never 'optimal'

weapons.name: W3_metaheuristic_search

trigger.saturation_signal: subject to the tripwire: blocked once STRUCTURAL_GAP fires
trigger.fires_before: nothing — it is the cheap first rung ONLY on genuinely-open ground

verifier.verifier_cmd: arena verifier on best object; report as LOWER BOUND with witness, never optimal

weapons.expected_lift: trivial 64 -> greedy 80 -> ILS 88 (cap-set n=6); plateaus ~70-80% of target
weapons.failure_mode: plateau below known bound -> tripwire fires -> forced weapon-class switch (LNS went BACKWARD on cap-set: trap risk)

weapons.name: W4_evolutionary_program_search

trigger.saturation_signal: drawn when W3 saturates on open ground

verifier.verifier_cmd: the fitness oracle IS the checker; every LLM-proposed construction 0%-trusted
verifier.rule: LLM constructions are fabrication-prone (Haiku+Sonnet fabricated 100% raw) -> checker mandatory

weapons.expected_lift: n=6 cap-set 81 -> 96 (2026-06-08, strategy not persisted); static-priority family verified to 80
weapons.failure_mode: no cheap oracle -> DO NOT DRAW; greedy-priority ceiling (80-96) without non-greedy machinery

weapons.name: W5_symmetry_group_action

intake_signatures: large symmetry group inflating an otherwise-feasible search
trigger.fires_before: router must CONFIRM the symmetry is real, not assumed (symmetry-frame CP-SAT scored 41<90)

verifier.rule: orbit-reduced result re-expanded and re-checked in the full space

weapons.expected_lift: unmeasured positive; one measured NEGATIVE (41 < 90) when the frame was wrong
weapons.failure_mode: assumed-but-absent symmetry actively harms -> verify the group before drawing

weapons.name: W6_closed_form_pricer_factor_model

intake_signatures: pricing/edge question with known closed-form or statistical structure
trigger.saturation_signal: single-split edge that walk-forward flips = the saturation analogue -> ABSTAIN

verifier.verifier_cmd: machine recomputation + out-of-sample walk-forward via Artifacts/trading/real_world.py
verifier.rule: in-sample fit is never the verdict

weapons.expected_lift: unquantified; the trading analogue of fetching Potechin
weapons.failure_mode: no closed form / structure -> fall back to W3-style search with walk-forward gating

weapons.name: W7_exact_symbolic_numerics

intake_signatures: integral/ODE/sum/optimization with a closed form or tight analytic bound
trigger.fires_before: Monte-Carlo / grid search (do NOT sample what you can solve)

verifier.verifier_cmd: cross-check symbolic answer vs high-precision numerical eval — two independent engines must agree
verifier.rule: single-engine answers are claims, not results

weapons.expected_lift: exactness at near-zero B where sampling gives error bars
weapons.failure_mode: no closed form -> numeric with explicit error bars

weapons.name: W8_retrieval_grounded_structure_fetch

trigger.saturation_signal: also drawn when the tripwire fires on a misclassified task
trigger.fires_before: ANY solver is staffed (the GROUND-FIRST GATE)

verifier.verifier_cmd: the fetched source itself + downstream machine instantiation
verifier.rule: FORBID LLM-memory recall of constructions; 'value confirmed, no coordinates' -> ESCALATE to primary paper, never fall back to search

weapons.expected_lift: time_to_first_source minutes vs hours of saturated search (cap-set: ~100% of pre-paper budget was cost-of-delay)
weapons.failure_mode: no source reachable -> HONEST_ABSTAIN on the fetch, log the gap; if target is genuinely open -> reclassify OPEN
